_comment: A starting point for packaging labelling, seeded as a DRAFT (ADR-042 decision 7). Not approved, and nothing may be officially rendered with it until somebody signs for it.
_shape: Short, large and high contrast. Labelling text is read off a carton at arm's length, often by somebody who is not looking for it - so it is set larger than either of the others and given room, rather than fitted to a page.
name: Packaging labelling (starting point, not approved)
stylesheet: body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 30rem; margin: 2rem auto; padding: 0 1rem; color: #000; } h1 { font-size: 1.6rem; } h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; margin-top: 1.8rem; } p, li { font-weight: 500; }
